newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BIRZAI DAIRY FIVE MONTHS SALES 43.6 MLN LTL.
newsitem.headline: BIRZAI DAIRY FIVE MONTHS SALES 43.6 MLN LTL.

text.p: Lithuanian bourse official list company Birzai Dairy said on Tuesday that its sales during the first five months rose to 43.6 million litas from 34.5 million litas in the same period in 1996.
The director general of the company Vladas Songaila also told Reuters that sales in May rose to 9.3 million litas compared to 8.2 million litas in April.
"Our local sales in May were 5.2 million litas, a 400,000 litas rise compared to April," Songaila said.
The company was expecting export sales to exceed local ones in June, he said.
Songaila said that the company controlled around 12 percent of the local milk products market in May.
Birzai sales for 1996 amounted to 95.56 million litas and it had net profits of 1.223 million litas in the first four months.
The company's audited net profit for 1996 was 2.02 million litas.
